versions.changelog:
Initial release: Huawei Cloud alarm binding inspection across CES and AOM.

- Extracts core instances and CES/AOM metric and event baselines from Excel.
- Fetches alarm rules across regions using CES SDK and hcloud CLI, with AK/SK authentication.
- Enriches instances with metric dimensions and analyzes baseline binding coverage.
- Generates instance-level binding reports and remediation suggestions in Excel and HTML.
